description: Fermate trasporto pubblico locale (AMT) individuate dal Piano di eliminazione delle barriere architettoniche P.E.B.A is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mappe.comune.genova.it. Local public transport (AMT) stops identified as part of the P.E.B.A. The Municipality of Genoa, in implementation of Law No 41 of 28 February 1986, by Decision (DGC) No 143 of 14 July 2016, began the process of drafting the Plan for the Elimination of Architectural Barriers (P.E.B.A.), which ended with approval by the Municipal ... Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Local public transport (AMT) stops identified by the P.E.B.A Architectural Barrier Elimination Plan" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include barriere architettoniche, accessibilità, opendata, fermate autobus. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
